import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

def task_func(df, target_values=[1, 3, 4]):
    """
    Replace values not in target_values with 0 in each DataFrame column,
    then plot the distribution of each column after replacement.

    Returns
    -------
    matplotlib.axes.Axes
        An Axes object from the plotted data.
    """
    replaced_df = df.copy()
    target_set = set(target_values)

    for col in replaced_df.columns:
        replaced_df[col] = replaced_df[col].where(replaced_df[col].isin(target_set), 0)

    if replaced_df.shape[1] == 0:
        fig, ax = plt.subplots()
        return ax

    fig, axes = plt.subplots(
        nrows=replaced_df.shape[1],
        ncols=1,
        figsize=(8, 4 * replaced_df.shape[1]),
        squeeze=False,
    )

    axes = axes.flatten()

    for ax, col in zip(axes, replaced_df.columns):
        sns.countplot(x=replaced_df[col], ax=ax, color="steelblue")
        ax.set_title(col)
        ax.set_xlabel(col)
        ax.set_ylabel("Count")

    plt.tight_layout()
    return axes[0]
